hard_failures: Problems 2 and 4 require two read-off points, problems 3 and 9 require equations, and problem 12 requires a model equation; verification checks only derived rates or terminal values.
Problems 7 and 11 require graph interpretation in words, but neither is marked manual and the worksheet is reported with zero manual items.

errors.description: Required points, equations, and open graph interpretations are outside verification.

artifact_findings: All independently recomputed rates, equations, evaluations, and application results agree with the answer key.
Visual review confirms exactly 12 cleanly laid-out problems with readable tables and graphs.
rationale: The representation sequence is mathematically sound and well designed, but many of the representations the worksheet asks students to produce are not checked. Rejection is required.
